Pick a format: the TCG banlist, Genesys points, and Duel Links limit slots are applied as you build. All cards in the format are shown, including Forbidden ones: if you tap one, it tells you it can't be used.

Tap a card on the right to add it (Extra Deck monsters go to their own section automatically). Use «Side» to send the card to the Side Deck. On each card in the deck you can remove or add copies, and switch the artwork if it has more than one.

Duel Links: Main Deck of 20 to 30 cards (current decklists usually run 30), up to 9 in the Extra Deck, and no Side Deck for now.

Below the deck there's a space to write how it works and its combos. Export as YDK, a YDKE link, a PNG image with the real cards, or a text list. You can also import any of those formats and open the meta decklists in the builder.
<span class=\"ok\">El mazo cumple las re: <span class="ok">The deck follows the rules of
Cada jugador empieza con 8000 puntos de: Each player starts with 8000 Life Points (LP). You win when your opponent's LP reach 0, when they have no cards left to draw at the start of their turn, or through a card's special win condition. You build a Main Deck of 40 to 60 cards, an Extra Deck of up to 15, and a Side Deck of up to 15 to swap cards between games.
Cada lado tiene 5 Zonas de Monstruos, 5: Each side has 5 Monster Zones, 5 Spell & Trap Zones, the Field Zone, the Graveyard (GY, where used cards go), «banished» cards (removed from play), and the Extra Deck. There are also 2 shared Extra Monster Zones, used mostly by Extra Deck monsters.
Robar (Draw), Inicio (Standby), Fase Pri: Draw, Standby, Main Phase 1, Battle Phase, Main Phase 2, and End Phase. In the Main Phases you play cards, Summon, and activate effects. In the Battle Phase your monsters attack. The player who goes first can't attack on their first turn, and in the TCG doesn't draw.
Monstruos (atacan y defienden, la mayorí: Monsters (they attack and defend, and most have an effect), Spells (played on your turn, some are fast) and Traps (set face-down and activated on any turn, starting from the next one). Each type has subtypes: Continuous, Equip, Field, Ritual, Quick-Play, Counter.
Normal (1 por turno, Nivel 1 a 4 sin sac: Normal Summon (1 per turn, Level 1 to 4 with no Tribute, 5 or 6 with 1 Tribute, 7 or more with 2), Special Summon (allowed by an effect, no limit on times) and the ones that use the Extra Deck: Fusion (you gather the specified materials), Synchro (a Tuner + other monsters whose Levels add up to the Synchro's), Xyz (monsters of the same Level that stay underneath as materials), Link (Summoned by sending monsters to the GY; they have no Level and their arrows show which zones they point to) and Pendulum (you Summon several monsters at once from your hand using two Scales). Ritual uses a Ritual Spell and is Summoned from the hand.
Cuando activás una carta o efecto, tu ri: When you activate a card or effect, your opponent can respond with another one. That builds a «chain», which resolves from last to first. That's why order matters: the last card played is the first to apply. Quick Effects and Traps are what you use to respond on your opponent's turn.
Quien va primero arma su tablero sin ser: Whoever goes first builds their board without being attacked. Whoever goes second draws an extra card and can respond. Many meta decks want to go first to set up a hand of negates, and others prefer going second to break the opponent's board.
TCG: el juego tradicional con su lista d: TCG: the traditional game with its Forbidden, Limited, and Semi-Limited list. Genesys: a format where each card has points and your deck can't go over the cap (100 on this page), with no Link or Pendulum. Duel Links: the mobile version of the game, with cards limited by shared slots and its own rules. Speed Duel and Rush Duel are simplified versions with smaller fields.
Busca bajar vida rápido con monstruos gr: Aims to drop Life Points fast with big monsters or lots of attacks. If the opponent doesn't stop the advance in the first few turns, they lose. It's the easiest style to understand.
Encadena muchos efectos en un solo turno: Chains lots of effects in a single turn to leave a board full of monsters and negates. Requires knowing the sequencing well. It's the dominant style in the current meta.
No gana por velocidad: responde a lo que: Doesn't win on speed: it responds to what the opponent does (negating, destroying, banishing) and wins through card advantage. Plays mostly Traps and Quick Effects.
Mezcla combo y control: arma un tablero: Mixes combo and control: builds a decent board and holds resources to respond. It's flexible and more forgiving of mistakes.
Cartas que frenan al rival (limitan lo q: Cards that lock the opponent down (limiting what they can Summon or activate) until it can win with very little. Very fun to play and even more frustrating to face.
Busca ganar en un solo turno (OTK) o dir: Aims to win in a single turn (OTK) or straight on the first turn (FTK) with an exact combination. It's all or nothing.
Tiene una carta que busca a otras según: Has a card that searches for others depending on the situation. It adapts to what the opponent plays without relying on a single play.
Mazo de Sincro que juega alrededor de la: Synchro deck that plays around the center Monster Zone: that's where its main cards are Summoned and work. It has many Quick Effects, so it's a nuisance on the opponent's turn too.
Mazo de Tuners (los monstruos que se usa: Tuner deck (the monsters used to Summon Synchros). Its field spell allows an extra Normal Summon of a Tuner, and with that it builds Synchros that protect its Tuners and negate the opponent.
Mazo de monstruos tipo Trueno con Trampa: Deck of Thunder-Type monsters with Continuous Traps. Several of its cards can be revealed from the hand during the opponent's turn to destroy a monster and keep Summoning.
Mazo de Fusión que arma dragones grandes: Fusion deck that builds big Dragons using materials from the hand, the field, and the GY. It's one of the strongest and one of the most complex: you have to learn the sequencing.
Mezcla Dark Magician con Rituales de Cao: Mixes Dark Magician with Chaos Rituals (Black Luster Soldier, Magician of Dark Chaos). It relies on playing a few but powerful Ritual monsters.
Variante enfocada en los Rituales de Cao: Variant focused on Chaos Rituals: with «Light and Darkness Ritual» you Summon Black Luster Soldier or Magician of Dark Chaos using monsters from the hand or field, or by banishing from the GY.
Mazo de Fusión con Medius the Pure. Cuan: Fusion deck with Medius the Pure. When the field has 3 or more different Types of monster, it can negate and destroy whatever the opponent activates.
Mazo basado en Hechizos que se activan u: Deck based on Spells activated one after another and on the Link Sky Striker Ace. Each Spell you use builds up resources, and the deck wins through consistency and pressure.
Fusion deck with Aleister the Invoker. It's played on its own or as an engine inside other decks, because it turns cards into a quick Fusion from the hand.
